name: Heat and Mass Transfer
description: Fundamentals of heat and mass transfer. Conduction, resistance concept, extended surfaces, lumped capacitance. Introduction to convection, boundary layer theory, natural and forced convection, correlations for heat transfer coefficient; Radiative heat transfer; Types and design of heat exchangers: log mean temperature difference (LMTD), Number of transfer units (NTU); Diffusion and mass transfer coefficient, Interphase mass transfer, overall mass transfer coefficient, correlations for mass transfer coefficient, mass transfer with chemical reaction, simultaneous heat and mass transfer, analogy between momentum, heat and mass transfer.
